page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities, as evidenced by top-quartile results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core tests, and PassMark CPU scores. The instance demonstrates strong performance in multi-threaded tasks such as bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. However, single-core performance remains in the average tier across stress-ng and Geekbench single-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register within the average range, though PassMark memory and database operations score in the strong tier.

With its high physical core count and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance offers resource density suitable for multi-threaded workloads, including static web serving, database operations, and small-scale language model inference. It achieves strong prompt processing and text generation speeds with a 135M parameter model, though performance drops to average levels when scaling to a 7B parameter model. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance for compute-heavy and memory-balanced workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or hardware accelerators.
